name: print-social-violet-cybersecurity-slide-format-posts
title: Violet cybersecurity landscape posts with shield and lock 3D objects
whatItIs: A lavender portfolio cover headed 'Social Media Designs for CyberGuard' with three stacked wide cards in purple. Each is split between a text panel and a visual: a 3D shield, a person on a bed with a device, and a laptop with lock icons.
whatItMeans: Secure and modern; gradients and glossy objects feel protective yet friendly.
techniques: Split wide cards into text and image halves.
Use 3D glossy security icons as hero objects.
Keep one purple gradient for the set.
Present a cover in lighter lavender to contrast with dark cards.

vocabulary.definition: A card divided into text and visual halves.
A glossy rendered shield or lock.
A lighter cover matching darker content.
